tickets.title: Tickets
tickets.panelDescription: Click below to create a ticket.
tickets.welcomeDescription: Hello, the support team will reply as soon as possible.
tickets.closedNotice: This ticket is now closed. Only the support team can reopen or delete it.
tickets.reopenedNotice: This ticket has been reopened. You can write here again.
tickets.OPEN_TICKET_EXISTS: You already have an open ticket.
tickets.PERSISTENCE_ERROR: The ticket could not be saved. Please contact the server staff.
tickets.TICKET_GUILD_OR_MEMBER_MISSING: This ticket action requires a server member context.
tickets.TICKET_CHANNEL_CREATION_FAILED: The ticket channel could not be created.
tickets.TICKET_NAME_UNAVAILABLE: The ticket name could not be generated. Please try again shortly.
tickets.TICKET_MEMBER_MISSING: The ticket creator is no longer available in this server.
tickets.TICKET_BOT_MISSING: The bot member is unavailable in this server.
tickets.TICKET_PERMISSION_INSUFFICIENT: The bot does not have sufficient permissions to configure this ticket.
tickets.TICKET_OVERWRITE_FAILED: The ticket permissions could not be configured.
tickets.TICKET_WELCOME_SEND_FAILED: The ticket welcome message could not be sent.
tickets.TICKET_NOT_FOUND: This channel is not an active CIVRAT ticket.
tickets.TICKET_ALREADY_DELETED: This ticket has already been deleted.
tickets.TICKET_UNAUTHORIZED: You are not allowed to close this ticket.
tickets.TICKET_GUILD_MISMATCH: This ticket does not belong to this server.
tickets.TICKET_CLOSE_FAILED: The ticket could not be closed.
tickets.TICKET_REOPEN_FAILED: The ticket could not be reopened.
tickets.TICKET_DELETE_FAILED: The ticket could not be deleted.
tickets.TICKET_RENAME_FAILED: The ticket could not be renamed.
tickets.TICKET_ALREADY_CLAIMED: This ticket has already been claimed.
tickets.TICKET_CLAIM_FAILED: The ticket could not be claimed.
tickets.TICKET_MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: The member was not found in this server.
tickets.TICKET_MEMBER_ALREADY_ADDED: This member already has ticket access.
tickets.TICKET_MEMBER_NOT_ADDED: This member has no specific ticket access.
tickets.TICKET_MEMBER_ADDED: The member was added to the ticket.
tickets.TICKET_MEMBER_REMOVED: The member was removed from the ticket.
tickets.TICKET_MEMBER_ACCESS_FAILED: The ticket member access could not be updated.
tickets.TICKET_DISCORD_ERROR: A Discord error occurred while preparing the ticket.
tickets.premiumLockedDescription: Ticket panel customization (title, description, color, image, button label) requires CIVRAT Premium for this server. Free settings remain unchanged and keep working.
tickets.premiumActiveDescription: These customizations apply to the panel sent by /ticketpanel. Any value left empty falls back to the Free default.
tickets.premiumResetDone: Premium panel reset to Free defaults.
tickets.premiumErrorTitle: Invalid title: 1 to 256 characters, or empty to keep the Free default.
tickets.premiumErrorDescription: Invalid description: 1 to 2000 characters, or empty to keep the Free default.
tickets.premiumErrorImage: Invalid image URL: an https URL of at most 1024 characters, or empty.
tickets.premiumErrorButtonLabel: Invalid button label: 1 to 80 characters, or empty.
tickets.premiumErrorGeneric: The Premium panel values were rejected.
tickets.premiumErrorWelcomeMessage: Invalid welcome message: 1 to 2000 characters, or empty to keep the Free default.
tickets.premiumErrorNameFormat: Invalid name format: lowercase letters, digits, - and _ only, with at least one of {number} {username} {userid}, 90 characters max, or empty for the Free default.
tickets.premiumNameFormatHelp: Naming format placeholders: {number} {username} {userid} — e.g. ticket-{number} → ticket-001.
tickets.TRANSPORT_ERROR: Ticket panel could not be sent.
tickets.permissionDenied: You do not have permission to manage tickets.
